## Checklist

- [ ] `npm run check:all` passes
- [ ] New/changed findings carry evidence, a `status` and a `recommended_human_action`
- [ ] Rule changes: expectation in `test/acceptance/expected/` updated first and seen failing
- [ ] Fixtures are synthetic; no secrets or proprietary models
- [ ] `CHANGELOG.md` updated; sample outputs regenerated if report output changed
